messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the launch criteria for the Q3 Quickstarts + SDK v2 by EOW. Can we run through what is must-have vs nice-to-have?

jon: I think must-have = 1) runnable sample app (local + cloud), 2) CI smoke test, 3) basic telemetry snippets, 4) 1-page quickstart README. Everything else is stretch.

lee: Docs + tutorials note — also need a troubleshooting section and a clear 'what's next' section (links to full API refs). Est: 2-3 days per quickstart for first pass.

samir: Customer ask from Integrations partner: sample showing token-level cost breakdown in the console + how to enable caching. Could be a short video or gif. Marking as high-impact.

maria: Proposed acceptance criteria (compact):
- README + 3-min CLI quickstart that runs a sample app locally
- sample app demonstrates: generation, streaming, and an embedding call
- CI: one integration test that runs in < 5m (smoke)
- telemetry: example tracing snippet + where to view token costs in Console
- security: mention KMS config steps for private deployments

jon: For the sample app, I suggest Node + Python variants. Minimal API usage:
```bash
# run locally
git clone .../quickstart-node && cd quickstart-node
npm install
REDDW_API_KEY=xxx npm start
```
And a tiny package.json script: 
```json
{"scripts": {"start": "node app.js", "test": "node smoke.js"}}
```

lee: Docs question — do we include full SDK reference in the quickstart repo or only links? Full reference duplicates maintenance. My vote: include inline doc snippets + link to canonical reference on site.

samir: +1 to link. But include a one-page generated markdown of “API calls used” so SEs can copy-paste.

maria: Timelines: dev complete by Thu, docs + CI by Fri, internal review Fri afternoon. If any blockers, flag now.

jon: Blocker: we still need an example for private deployment KMS flow. Who owns?

lee: I can write the KMS doc, but need sample config from infra. If infra can give a trimmed terraform snippet we can include.

samir: I'll request the snippet from infra and ping here when they reply.

ci-bot: CI build for branch quickstart/sdks-v2 started (build #482)

jon: CI is failing on the smoke test because of a flaky network dependency. I'll add a retry wrapper, should be quick. :wrench:

maria: Good. Owners + action items:
- jon: finalize Node + Python sample app + make smoke tests stable (owner)
- lee: write troubleshooting + KMS doc + generate api-call markdown (owner)
- samir: get infra KMS snippet + record short gif for token-cost in Console (owner)
- maria: coordinate internal review and create launch checklist PR (owner)

jon: ETA for my items: tomorrow noon PST.

lee: ETA docs: Friday EOD.

samir: I'll follow up with infra today and aim to have snippet + gif by Thu.

maria: Thanks all — I'll open a PR with the checklist and invite reviewers. If anyone gets blocked please call it out here. :thumbsup:

jon: :thumbsup:

lee: :thumbsup:

samir: will do.
